lines.serbian: Sedam je sati ujutru.
lines.croatian: Sedam je sati ujutro.
lines.english: It's seven in the morning.

lines.serbian: Ana i Marko još leže u krevetu.
lines.croatian: Ana i Marko još leže u krevetu.
lines.english: Ana and Marko are still lying in bed.

lines.serbian: Njihov pas Reks stoji pored vrata i laje.
lines.croatian: Njihov pas Reks stoji pored vrata i laje.
lines.english: Their dog Reks is standing by the door and barking.

lines.serbian: – Marko, ko šeta psa danas?
lines.croatian: – Marko, tko šeta psa danas?
lines.english: "Marko, who's walking the dog today?"

lines.serbian: – Ti, naravno.
lines.croatian: – Ti, naravno.
lines.english: "You, of course."

lines.serbian: – Ja? Zašto ja? Šetala sam ga juče!
lines.croatian: – Ja? Zašto ja? Šetala sam ga jučer!
lines.english: "Me? Why me? I walked him yesterday!"

lines.serbian: – A ja sam ga šetao u ponedeljak.
lines.croatian: – A ja sam ga šetao u ponedjeljak.
lines.english: "And I walked him on Monday."

lines.serbian: – To je bilo pre četiri dana!
lines.croatian: – To je bilo prije četiri dana!
lines.english: "That was four days ago!"

lines.serbian: Marko gleda kroz prozor.
lines.croatian: Marko gleda kroz prozor.
lines.english: Marko looks out of the window.

lines.serbian: – Pada kiša. Reks ne voli kišu.
lines.croatian: – Pada kiša. Reks ne voli kišu.
lines.english: "It's raining. Reks doesn't like rain."

lines.serbian: – Reks voli kišu. Ti ne voliš kišu.
lines.croatian: – Reks voli kišu. Ti ne voliš kišu.
lines.english: "Reks likes rain. You don't like rain."

lines.serbian: Reks donosi povodac i stavlja ga na krevet.
lines.croatian: Reks donosi povodac i stavlja ga na krevet.
lines.english: Reks brings the leash and puts it on the bed.

lines.serbian: Ana se smeje.
lines.croatian: Ana se smije.
lines.english: Ana laughs.

lines.serbian: – Vidiš? On je izabrao tebe.
lines.croatian: – Vidiš? On je izabrao tebe.
lines.english: "See? He chose you."

lines.serbian: Marko uzdiše i ustaje iz kreveta.
lines.croatian: Marko uzdiše i ustaje iz kreveta.
lines.english: Marko sighs and gets out of bed.

lines.serbian: – Dobro, idem. Ali ti praviš kafu.
lines.croatian: – Dobro, idem. Ali ti kuhaš kavu.
lines.english: "Fine, I'm going. But you're making the coffee."

lines.serbian: – Dogovoreno!
lines.croatian: – Dogovoreno!
lines.english: "Deal!"

lines.serbian: Posle deset minuta Marko i Reks se vraćaju.
lines.croatian: Nakon deset minuta Marko i Reks se vraćaju.
lines.english: Ten minutes later, Marko and Reks come back.

lines.serbian: Obojica su mokri.
lines.croatian: Obojica su mokri.
lines.english: They're both wet.

lines.serbian: Reks je srećan. Marko nije.
lines.croatian: Reks je sretan. Marko nije.
lines.english: Reks is happy. Marko isn't.

lines.serbian: Na stolu ga čeka topla kafa.
lines.croatian: Na stolu ga čeka topla kava.
lines.english: A hot coffee is waiting for him on the table.

lines.serbian: – Sutra ti šetaš psa – kaže Marko.
lines.croatian: – Sutra ti šetaš psa – kaže Marko.
lines.english: "Tomorrow you walk the dog," says Marko.

lines.serbian: Ana pije kafu i smeje se.
lines.croatian: Ana pije kavu i smije se.
lines.english: Ana drinks her coffee and laughs.

lines.serbian: – Videćemo.
lines.croatian: – Vidjet ćemo.
lines.english: "We'll see."
